tasks.subject: Task 4: Per-entry CAF id regions + mint wrap guard (door 3)
tasks.description:

**Files:** src/Wok/Interp/Machine.hs, src/Wok/Interp/Sched.hs, test/run-golden/conc-foreign-caf-escape.expected.

